event: Four Franciscana Management Areas (FMA I–IV) proposed
PAN Toninha, 1st cycle, approved: avoid population decline between Espírito Santo and Rio Grande do Sul (7 goals)
Listed as Critically Endangered in Brazil
IWC adopts the Franciscana CMP, the first CMP for a small cetacean
Eleven management units proposed (ten FMA subdivisions and Babitonga Bay)
National list update keeps the species as Critically Endangered
IWC Scientific Committee recognises the 11 FMAs as units for assessment
CMS COP14 (Samarkand) adopts Concerted Action 14.5 for the franciscana
International workshop to prepare the IWC assessment (July; 45 participants)
CMS COP15 (Campo Grande, March) renews the Concerted Action for 2026–2029
IWC Comprehensive Assessment begins with FMAs Ia, Ib, IIa, IIb and III; aerial surveys of FMAs IVa–IVe; bycatch mitigation workshop with the IWC
Bycatch mitigation action plan; regional workshop on standardised monitoring; awareness campaigns
Endorsement of assessments and recommendations to improve the CMP (2026 and 2028); pilot mitigation in at least three priority sites
Final assessment of the Concerted Action and consolidated regional report (by March)
